  path={"/v4/stats/stats"}
  context={"endpoint"}

</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieve statistics with buckets and/or totals for a time range. If granularity is not specified, the method returns the smallest number of buckets by combining MONTH/DAY/HOUR buckets as needed. The response `granularity` will be the smallest granularity present in the returned buckets.
